manual.text:
## Specific task description

Task instruction: Put the lightweight bell with smooth surface to the right of the hand-sized wireless mouse.

Task description: Move the lightweight bell with a silver dome and dark base to the right of the dark-gray wireless mouse. “Right” refers to the table’s left-right direction and does not change with the mouse’s own orientation.

Success criteria: Place the bell close to the right of the mouse, approximately aligned front to back with moderate spacing, neither too close nor too far. Both grippers must be open.

## Execution tips

- Where possible, grasp the sides of the dark base where the finger pads can fit, avoiding the sloped surface of the smooth rounded top where the gripper can slip. The opening can be slightly wider than the selected section to reduce brushing during approach.
- Use a side view before closing to confirm the fingers straddle the grasp region and both pads have effective contact space. Avoid tightening based only on image overlap and pushing the lightweight bell aside.
- Use the tabletop grid in the head-camera view to judge the placement point on the right and check front-back alignment, avoiding a result where the bell is to the right but still noticeably offset from the mouse.
- During placement, set the base steadily on the table before releasing. Watch the clearance between the mouse and bell as the fingers withdraw, avoiding an unsupported release or moving the object through contact.
